{#- SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-or-later The pages of the /virtual-serial-studio/ section. Paths are relative to the site's root. Add a page here when it exists: tools/ci/check_site_pages.py follows every link. Import this file with context (`{% import "partials/links.html" as links with context %}`), because `download` reads `config`. menus: the app bar of the front pages, in order. Each entry is (label, path, items). An entry with items is a menu that opens (a native
, no script); each item is (path, label, one line on what is there). An entry with no items is a plain link. The menus of docs/plan/site.md are added with their pages, so that no menu leads to a page that is not there. Products, Platforms and Solutions are here; Quality and security, Pricing and Resources come with their pages. download: where the Download button of the app bar goes, as (path, label): the Downloads page. bar: the slim bar above the guide's own header, back to the front pages. more: the row of links above the company footer. -#} {%- set menus = [ ("Guide", "guide/", []), ("Products", "products/", [ ("products/", "All products", "What is in the box, and what is in the packages today."), ("products/studio/", "Studio", "Make, share and link virtual serial ports, and watch the traffic."), ("products/command-line/", "Command line", "vss_cli: ports, setups, capture, replay and scripted devices, with no window."), ("products/agent-gateway/", "Agent and gateway", "Drive ports from a test script, with a JUnit report.
